content:
Donald Trump has reportedly given every member of his Cabinet a flat-screen monitor dedicated to displaying his social media posts.

The screens “exclusively” show posts from the president’s Truth Social feed, according to a New Yorker profile of Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent published Monday.

Bessent referred to the device during New Yorker journalist Jason Zengerle’s visit to his Treasury Department office earlier this month, reading a Trump post on the screen to the reporter.

It’s not the first time a member of Trump’s inner circle has been reported to have a screen dedicated to the president’s social media musings.

Vanity Fair reported in its December 2025 profile of then-White House chief of staff Susie Wiles that she had a freestanding video monitor in her office displaying “a live feed of Trump’s Truth Social posts.”

Trump’s gift-giving to top officials also extends beyond technology.

Earlier this year, it emerged that the president had bought shoes for Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

It was subsequently revealed that Trump had handed out pairs of his favorite footwear to several others in his administration and political allies, too.
